Can be used to display any (public) variable used inside any object.
Useful for doing calculations and checking on values while patching or coding objects.

Usage: Paste the object name to sniff at in the "sniffobj" text field.
Then open the "sniffvariable" edit box and paste the variable to sniff at, plain and without semicolon or other symbols.

Example: We want to display the variable "stuff_happening" inside the object labeled "my_filter1".
sniffobj: my_filter1
sniffvariable: stuff_happening

zoom: aka bitshift left. A zoom of 0 displays the unscaled sniffed-at value. Each number above 0 doubles the sniffed-at value.
Example: You want to see some variable "my_counter" on the chart but it only goes from 0 to 255.
Increase "zoom" until the value fills out the chart box. (Should be at zoom of 19?)

    may be actual MIDI device ports.
